media:content.media:description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. But one person who didn’t take the stand was Clancy herself. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. Misty Marris breaks down what each side read from the diaries, and what they suggested her unspoken words mean for the case.

item.title: The unspoken testimony in the Lindsay Clancy trial

item.description: NASA on Sunday is set to launch a next-generation telescope into space that’s expected to survey hundreds of millions of stars and billions of galaxies.

media:content.media:text: Scientists in a cherry picker observe the top of the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope at NASA Goddard Space Center in Greenbelt, Md. on May 22.
media:content.media:description: The $4.3 billion mission has been under development for nearly two decades and is set to launch nine months ahead of schedule.

media:content.media:text: Nancy Grace Roman Telescope
media:content.media:description: Though the Roman telescope is often compared to Hubble, which launched in 1990 and has captured some of the most dramatic and memorable views of the cosmos, Roman’s capabilities far outpace its predecessor’s.

item.title: NASA readies to launch its next-generation space telescope
